summary: CR-066 Unit Price Management Tab testing complete. All 8 features tested and working correctly: tab navigation, bulk edit visibility, unit prices sections, set price, edit price, delete price, search filter, and tab switch back.
critical_code_review_comments: All CR-066 data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Tab strip, sections, inline forms, and modals all have correct test IDs
Currency hardcoded as ₹ as per requirements
Unit price calculation (price ÷ quantity) working correctly
seed_data_creation: Created test price for '100 delivery' item (₹50, then edited to ₹75, then deleted) - cleaned up after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-066 Unit Price Management feature fully implemented and tested. External API (preprod.mygenie.online) is live. Login takes ~15-20 seconds due to 6 API boot sequence. All unit price CRUD operations working via /api/v2/vendoremployee/expense/ endpoints.

TEST_1_TAB_NAVIGATION.description: Navigate to /expense-setup → verify two tabs visible: 'Stock Master' (default active with orange underline) and 'Unit Prices'
TEST_1_TAB_NAVIGATION.evidence: Tab strip found with data-testid='setup-tab-strip'. Stock Master tab active by default. Unit Prices tab clickable.

TEST_2_BULK_EDIT_VISIBILITY.description: On Stock Master tab: 'Bulk Edit' button visible. On Unit Prices tab: 'Bulk Edit' button hidden, only Refresh button visible
TEST_2_BULK_EDIT_VISIBILITY.evidence: Stock Master tab: Bulk Edit button visible=True. Unit Prices tab: Bulk Edit button hidden (not found in DOM). Refresh button visible on both tabs.

TEST_3_UNIT_PRICES_SECTIONS.description: Click 'Unit Prices' tab → two sections load: 'Not Priced Yet' (375 items) and 'Priced' (0 initially). Search bar visible.
TEST_3_UNIT_PRICES_SECTIONS.evidence: Not Priced Yet section shows 375 items. Priced section shows 0 items with 'No unit prices set yet' message. Search input found with data-testid='up-search-input'.

TEST_4_SET_PRICE.description: In 'Not Priced Yet' section: click 'Set Price' → inline form with Qty (default 1) and Price inputs. Enter price=50, confirm → item moves to 'Priced' section with ₹50.00/unit
TEST_4_SET_PRICE.evidence: Clicked Set Price for item ID 1125. Qty input default value: 1. Entered price: 50. Item moved to Priced section showing ₹50.00/unit. Toast: 'Price set ₹50.00/unit'.

TEST_5_EDIT_PRICE.description: In 'Priced' section: click Edit (pencil) → inline price edit input. Change price, confirm → price updates, unit price recalculates
TEST_5_EDIT_PRICE.evidence: Clicked Edit for item ID 33. Changed price to 75. After edit: ₹75.00 price, ₹75.00/unit. Toast: 'Price updated'.

TEST_6_DELETE_PRICE.description: In 'Priced' section: click Delete (trash) → confirmation modal appears. Confirm → item moves back to 'Not Priced Yet'
TEST_6_DELETE_PRICE.evidence: Delete confirmation modal appeared with data-testid='delete-price-confirm'. Confirmed delete. Priced section now shows 0 items. Toast: 'Price removed'.

TEST_7_SEARCH_FILTER.description: Search bar: type a query → both 'Not Priced Yet' and 'Priced' sections filter by item name
TEST_7_SEARCH_FILTER.evidence: Searched 'banana'. Not Priced Yet filtered to 12 items (Banana, Banana for 103, Banana from 103, etc.). Priced section shows 'No priced items match your search'.

TEST_8_TAB_SWITCH_BACK.description: Switch back to 'Stock Master' tab → existing categories and items display correctly, DnD layout present, Bulk Edit button reappears
TEST_8_TAB_SWITCH_BACK.evidence: Clicked Stock Master tab. Categories panel shows 8 categories. Items panel shows items. Bulk Edit button visible=True.

notes.external_api: App connects to preprod.mygenie.online Laravel backend
notes.login_time: Login takes ~15-20 seconds due to 6 API boot sequence (profile, categories, products, tables, settings, running orders)
notes.unit_price_endpoints: /api/v2/vendoremployee/expense/ namespace - all 5 CRUD endpoints verified working
notes.data_cleanup: Test price created and deleted during testing - no residual test data
